brief: CARD-008-MATERIAL-GAP.md with COMMON.md (pinned in artifacts of the order)

formulas.equal_face_mass: tf_new = tf_Al * rho_Al / rho_new; core thickness, separation d, joints and systems held at each pinned row
formulas.SF_b: SF_b,Al * (E/rho)/(E/rho)_Al, first order since tf << d (max tf/d in this table stated in RESULTS checks)
formulas.kd_scaling: every SF_b scales as kd/0.2; required E scales as 1/kd

candidates_input.name: 6061-T6 (baseline)
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: typical tensile yield transferred to compression, per pinned COMMON.md
candidates_input.source: Pinned COMMON.md (MAINLINE-001/002); ASM MatWeb 6061-T6 data sheet (AA typical values)

candidates_input.name: 7075-T6
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: tensile yield transferred to compression; no compressive yield retrieved
candidates_input.source: ASM MatWeb 7075-T6 data sheet; density 2.81 g/cc, E 71.7 GPa, tensile yield 503 MPa

candidates_input.name: Al-Li 2195-T8
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: tensile yield (L direction) transferred to compression
candidates_input.source: MatWeb 2195 composition/density sheet https://www.matweb.com/search/datasheet_print.aspx?matguid=4363dafc7f5545688506d8b4af1e9468 ; MakeItFrom 2195-T8 https://www.makeitfrom.com/compare/2195-2195-T8-Aluminum/B390.0-B390.0-F-SC174B-A23900-Cast-Aluminum (E 76 GPa, yield 560 MPa)

candidates_input.name: Ti-6Al-4V (annealed)
candidates_input.source: ASM MatWeb Ti-6Al-4V annealed data sheet (density 4.43 g/cc, E 113.8 GPa, compressive yield 970 MPa)

candidates_input.name: Mg AZ31B
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: compressive yield 97 MPa (rolled/extruded AZ31; tension-compression asymmetry retained, tensile yield not used)
candidates_input.source: AZ31 property table in https://zenodo.org/records/5519242/files/E27900610521.pdf (compressive yield 97 MPa); density 1.77 g/cc, E 45 GPa (ASM MatWeb AZ31B)

candidates_input.name: Beryllium S-200F
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: compressive yield 41 ksi = 283 MPa (tensile yield 37 ksi on the same page)
candidates_input.source: Materion beryllium data sheet https://hkvxni.files.cmp.optimizely.com/download/c3141b9ea04211ee9a7b2a5d2cb825d4 (S-200F density 1.85 g/cc, E 303 GPa); Brush/Materion Beryllium Guide MB-001 compressive-yield note

candidates_input.name: AlBeMet 162 (AM162, HIP)
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: HIP tensile yield transferred to compression
candidates_input.source: Materion AlBeMet technical data sheet https://web.archive.org/web/20171024043552/https://materion.com/[private path] (density 2.071 g/cc, E 193 GPa, HIP yield 193 MPa)

candidates_input.name: CFRP quasi-isotropic T700/epoxy
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: QI laminate estimate: E_QI ~ 0.40 x UD composite E (134 GPa, Toray T700S composite), sigma_c_QI ~ 0.33 x UD compressive strength; not fibre properties
candidates_input.source: Toray T700S data sheet https://www.rockwestcomposites.com/downloads/T700SDataSheet.pdf (fibre 230 GPa, 1.80 g/cc; composite tensile modulus 134 GPa); QI reduction stated in sigma_c_basis

candidates_input.name: CFRP quasi-isotropic M55J/epoxy
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: QI laminate estimate: UD E ~ 325 GPa (Vf 0.6 rule of mixtures on 540 GPa fibre), E_QI ~ 0.42 x UD; sigma_c_QI ~ 0.35 x estimated UD compressive strength; not fibre properties
candidates_input.source: Toray M55J data sheet https://www.toraycma.com/wp-content/uploads/M55J-Technical-Data-Sheet-1.pdf.pdf (fibre 540 GPa, 1.93 g/cc in Toray carbon-fibre card); QI reduction stated in sigma_c_basis

candidates_input.name: CFRP quasi-isotropic K13D2U pitch/epoxy
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: QI laminate estimate: UD E ~ 515 GPa (Vf 0.55 rule of mixtures on 935 GPa fibre), E_QI ~ 0.41 x UD; sigma_c_QI low, pitch high-modulus laminates are compression-weak; not fibre properties
candidates_input.source: Mitsubishi Chemical K13D2U tow data https://www.m-chemical.co.jp/carbon-fiber/en/product/tow/ (935 GPa, 3.70 GPa, 2.20 g/cc); QI reduction stated in sigma_c_basis

candidates_input.name: Boron/epoxy quasi-isotropic
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: QI laminate estimate: E_QI ~ 0.42 x UD E1 (204 GPa); sigma_c_QI ~ 0.34 x UD longitudinal compressive strength (2500 MPa); not fibre properties
candidates_input.source: Boron fibre review https://www.compositesworld.com/articles/boron-fiber-the-original-high-performance-fiber ; unidirectional boron/epoxy property table (E1 204 GPa, compressive 2500 MPa) in composites textbook extract https://structures.dhu.edu.cn/_upload/article/files/79/64/d90aa6424b14824d25a678e990c0/4ff4b286-e563-4c01-a7f0-ac45163b28a4.pdf

candidates_input.name: SiC (monolithic alpha SiC, Hexoloy SA type)
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: measured compressive strength of sintered SiC; flexural strength is only ~380 MPa and governs any bending/tension path (NFI)
candidates_input.source: Saint-Gobain Hexoloy SA data https://www.ceramicsrefractories.saint-gobain.com/pt/files/4731/view (compressive 3900 MPa, flexural 380 MPa); MatWeb alpha SiC https://www.matweb.com/search/datasheet_print.aspx?matguid=dd2598e783ba4457845586b58c8ea9fb (density 3.10 g/cc, E 410 GPa)

candidates_input.name: Metallic glass Vitreloy 1 (Zr41.2Ti13.8Cu12.5Ni10Be22.5)
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: compressive ultimate strength (bulk metallic glass has no distinct compressive yield; failure is shear-band fracture)
candidates_input.source: Review of Zr-based bulk metallic glasses https://www.mdpi.com/2075-4701/5/3/1262 (E 70-96 GPa, compressive ultimate 1400-1900 MPa for Vitreloy 1); density 6.12 g/cc typical for Vitreloy 1

candidates_input.name: CNT-yarn composite quasi-isotropic
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: PROJECTION scenario: QI laminate retaining ~50% of reported UD CNT-laminate specific modulus and a compressive strength below its reported UD tensile specific strength; no such QI structural laminate is available today
candidates_input.source: PROJECTION from UD CNT-yarn laminate report https://chemrxiv.org/engage/chemrxiv/article-details/639c91d7e8047a61d0eb2d2f (specific modulus 256 GPa per g/cc, specific tensile strength 1.71 GPa per g/cc, unidirectional)

candidates_input.name: Graphene composite quasi-isotropic
candidates_input.sigma_c_basis: PROJECTION scenario: graphene-reinforced laminate at a small fraction of monolayer graphene properties (E ~1 TPa); no structural graphene QI laminate is available today
candidates_input.source: PROJECTION; monolayer basis in Lee et al., Science 2008 (graphene E ~1.0 TPa, DOI 10.1126/science.1157996) and graphene-reinforced carbon fibre https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/sciadv.aaz4191
